method: Fixed real-player lineups from retention-squads.json; 32 original seeds plus the same 32 cases with seed + 13000 and id suffix -cards-holdout. Fixed 60 Hz. Read-only retention-calibration.mjs observers. No match quotas. LongBalls excludes crosses and clearances. Original v34 rows did not measure cards or clearances; use pairedBaseline16 for clearance comparison.
